T: Seven thousand years. Still time for dinner.
D: Immortal beings who have lived on Earth for thousands of years reunite to stop an ancient threat.
P: Serve the snacks when the Eternals track down Kingo on his film set.
S: Kingo's film set samosas with mint chutney
Kingo's career as a Bollywood star

Crisp pastry triangles stuffed with spiced potato, peas and garam masala, fried golden and served with a bright mint and coriander chutney. Boil 600g diced potatoes until tender. Fry 1 tsp cumin seeds and 1 diced onion, add 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 chopped green chilli, the potatoes and 100g peas, mash roughly and cool. Cut 6 spring roll wrappers into strips, fill and fold into triangles, sealing with flour paste. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Blend mint, coriander, 1 green chilli, 150g yoghurt and lemon juice for the chutney.
Charred za'atar flatbread, hummus with pomegranate seeds for dipping
Flatbreads brushed with olive oil, sprinkled with za'atar and grilled until blistered, torn and served with hummus scattered with pomegranate seeds.
Cucumber and cream cheese, egg and cress, crusts off
White bread spread with cream cheese and thin cucumber, and with egg mayonnaise and cress, crusts cut off and sliced into neat fingers.
M: Phastos at home with his husband and son in Chicago

Rare roast beef sliced paper thin, dunked in garlic and oregano beef juices, piled into soft rolls with spicy giardiniera pickles. Rub a 1kg beef topside with garlic, oregano, pepper and salt and roast at 220C for 15 minutes, then at 180C for 25 minutes until rare. Rest, chill for 1 hour and slice paper thin. Simmer 750ml beef stock with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano and 1 tsp chilli flakes for 10 minutes. Drop the beef into the hot stock for 1 minute, then pile into 4 soft long rolls with giardiniera and a spoon of juice.
Chicken mole with rice and tortillas
Chicken thighs in a dried chilli, almond and dark chocolate sauce
Chicken thighs in a mole of dried chillies, chocolate, spices and nuts, simmered until rich, with rice and tortillas.
W: Tahini and honey halva set in a loaf tin and sliced

Crumbly honey and tahini halva swirled with chopped dates and pistachios, set firm and cut into small squares to share. Line a small loaf tin with baking paper. Put 300g tahini in a bowl with a pinch of salt and 1 tsp vanilla. Heat 200g honey in a small pan to 120C on a thermometer, then quickly pour onto the tahini and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until it thickens and starts to pull away. Fold in 100g chopped dates and 40g pistachios, press into the tin and chill overnight before cutting.
K: Chilled date, honey and lemon drink with orange blossom and cardamom

Dates and honey blended with lemon and orange blossom water, strained and poured over ice with soda, mint and a pinch of cardamom. Soak 150g pitted dates in 300ml hot water for 15 minutes, then blend with 2 tbsp honey, the juice of 2 lemons, 1 tsp orange blossom water and a pinch of ground cardamom until smooth. Strain through a fine sieve and chill. Divide between 4 glasses of ice, top each with soda water and stir. Garnish with mint and a lemon slice.

m.n: Chicken mole with rice and tortillas
m.note: Chicken thighs in a dried chilli, almond and dark chocolate sauce
m.how: Toast and soak dried chillies, then blend with almonds, garlic, a little cinnamon and stock. Simmer the sauce 15 minutes and melt in 50g dark chocolate. Add 1kg chicken thighs and simmer 40 minutes until tender. Serve with long grain rice and tortillas.
